name: SPCAM3 aquaplanet simulations (-4K, +0K, +4K)
access: Raw output of the (+0K) simulation can be found at https://zenodo.org/record/1402384#.YaUCsdDMI-w. The full simulations output, which is several TB, is archived on the GreenPlanet cluster at UC Irvine and available upon request. Data accompanying paper: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.8140536

scales.note: 2-year global aquaplanet simulation; coarse GCM resolution is T42 (~2.8 deg, ~311 km) with 30-min output; embedded SAM CRM has 4 km resolution; size described as several TB.
